name: Galley Render API
description:
A template plus a JSON payload becomes a PDF, PNG or JPG behind a signed URL.

Every render is deterministic and cached: the cache key is a SHA-256 over the template
version's checksum, the output format, and the canonical JSON of the data and options.
An identical repeat request returns the stored object with `cached: true` and is not billed.

Small jobs finish inside the request and return `200` with a URL. A request carrying a
`webhook_url`, `async: true`, a large payload, or a batch item is queued and returns `202`
with an id to poll.

Agents can skip signup entirely: the MCP server at https://mcp.galleyrender.com/mcp mints a
trial of 10 PDF pages or 10 images on the first call and hands back a key that works here too.
